DORSET DIVISION / LEGAL

Cancellations & Refunds

Last updated: 25 October 2026

Contact me promptly

To cancel, pause or discuss a project, email marnie@dorsetdivision.co.uk or call 07342 729185. Please include your name, project reference and what you want to cancel. A clear statement is enough; use of the model form below is optional.

Consumers booking remotely

If you are an individual buying mainly outside your trade, business, craft or profession, you may be a consumer. For a service contract agreed online, by telephone or by email, the usual cancellation period ends 14 days after the day the contract is made, where the Consumer Contracts Regulations apply. You do not need to give a reason. Different rules and exceptions can apply; any applicable exception will be explained before you agree.

Starting during the cancellation period

If you want work to begin during the cancellation period, I will ask for your express request before starting. If you then cancel, you may owe a proportionate amount for services supplied up to cancellation only where the legal requirements for that charge have been met. You lose the cancellation right for a fully performed service only after the required prior express consent and acknowledgement. Accepting general terms alone does not record a separate request to start early.

Digital content

Where a contract separately supplies digital content for immediate download or access, the applicable cancellation right is lost only when supply begins with the required express consent, acknowledgement and confirmation. Simply receiving a bespoke design or publishing service electronically does not automatically remove your service cancellation rights. The quote will identify what is being supplied.

Refunds during a statutory cancellation period

Where a statutory cancellation refund is due for a service, I will reimburse the amount required by law without undue delay and within 14 days of being informed of the cancellation. Any lawful proportionate charge for services already supplied will be explained. Refunds use the original payment method unless you expressly agree otherwise, without a refund administration fee.

Business projects and later cancellations

Business clients do not automatically receive the statutory consumer cooling-off period. After an applicable cooling-off period, cancellation is handled under the agreed contract and applicable law. I will account for completed work and reasonable unavoidable costs, take reasonable steps to limit losses and explain any proposed deduction. No blanket rule makes every deposit non-refundable, and no charge is imposed solely as a penalty.

Pauses, changes and problems

A pause or reschedule must be agreed; availability and revised dates cannot be assumed. Any extra cost requires prior agreement. If I cannot provide an agreed service, I will contact you and agree an appropriate next step, including a refund for undelivered services where due. If work does not meet the agreed standard, please contact me so I can investigate and provide an appropriate remedy. Cancellation terms do not remove statutory rights to repeat performance, a price reduction or other remedies where applicable.
